theoremName: finite overlapping between-node eigenrow disk cover
statement: The exact normalized negative endpoint eigenrow and its derivatives through order eight are enclosed on the requested interval by the union of the reported analytic Newton/Cauchy disks.

betweenNodeEigenrowDerivativeCoverStatus.label: exact finite between-node eigenrow derivative cover
betweenNodeEigenrowDerivativeCoverStatus.reason: Every local radii polynomial closes and the closed cells cover the interval.
